name: Abundia Global Impact Group Inc
business_overview: Abundia Global Impact Group Inc., technology solutions company, focuses on converting waste into renewable fuels and chemicals in the United States. The company offers renewable diesel, including ultra low sulfur diesel and low carbon marine fuels; sustainable aviation fuel; and renewable naphtha and other chemical feedstocks. It operates in the recycling and renewable energy, environmental change, fuels, and chemicals sectors. The company is based in Houston, Texas. Abundia Global Impact Group Inc. is a subsidiary of Abundia Financial, Llc.

classification_meta.logic_summary: Converts waste into renewable fuels and chemicals, selling to B2B customers in the US.

sources.snippet:
Agility Robotics Nears Public Debut: Safety Cert, S-4, and a 34x Valuation

agility robotics agilityrobotics.com

Churchill Capital Corp XI filed its second Form 425 with the SEC on Wednesday, July 8 — the most recent in a series of regulatory submissions that confirm the Agility Robotics SPAC merger is advancing on schedule. For retail investors watching the CCXI tape, the filing is a procedural update. For investors trying to understand when and why AGLT will finally trade on Nasdaq, it is a reminder that three gates still stand between today and the moment they can buy shares: an S-4 registration statement the company has not yet filed, a shareholder vote that cannot happen until the S-4 is effective, and a safety certification Agility does not fully control. The $2.5 billion valuation is set. The $620 million is raised. None of that makes AGLT a stock yet.
